text:
emily: dropping a quick design review for compact-playground controls. focus areas: streaming stop language, token counter behaviour, prompt-library keyboard affordances. putting up a few figma frames shortly.

raj: looked through frames. main UX risk is ambiguity around "Stop". users have different mental models. proposal: keep label "Stop" but add small caption under it: "Stops streaming — partial output retained". caption should always be available to screen readers.

sophia: agree. mobile long-press should show "Discard" and "Keep Partial" options. default tap = keep. avoid hidden gestures as only fallback.

emily: noted. also token pill update: during streaming the count animates a lot. a11y suggestion was debounce 200ms + aria-live="polite" and announce final state assertive. add spinner while server reconciles token count.

a11y-bot: test notes: make token pill hit-area >= 44px for touch, ensure focus ring visible in both themes, and respect prefers-reduced-motion for the count animation.

lou: prompt library keyboard flow: arrow nav to move, Enter to insert, Space to pin. items need role="button" and a visually-hidden label like "Insert prompt: <title>". header copy: change "Saved prompts" to "Prompt library".

raj: telemetry alignment: use event name `playground.interrupt` for Stop/Discard/Regenerate with method enum. sample: telemetry.track('playground.interrupt',{method:'stop',visible_tokens:12,variant:'compact-v1'})

emily: regen race bug reminder: if regen fires while stream teardown overlaps we double-bill on dedicated infra. filing INF-10021 for server idempotency key + client-side lock. mark P1 for billing risk.

sophia: dev checklist: caption under stop, long-press menu with keyboard fallback, token debounce+spinner+hit-area, prompt keyboard + hidden labels, copy change to Prompt library, telemetry rename, INF-10021. I'll update Figma and ping when frames ready.

emily: thanks — aiming to merge after a quick a11y pass. pinning landing checklist in thread. :tada:
